_comment: Config for derive_home_dynamics.py. Every key is optional; the script runs on internal defaults without this file. device_room_map is the fallback used when an event carries no room of its own - keep it in step with common_files/rooms.json.

thresholds._semantic_min_speaker_turn_share: Share of an exchange's turns a resident must hold before the exchange is attributed to them. Raising it buys precision at the cost of recall; see _named_speakers for the measurement.

semantic_mappings._comment: Merged over the built-in table. Add or override AudioSet labels here without touching the code.
